results.title: US soldier arrested in Britain on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence
results.content: UK police arrested a senior member of the US Army on Tuesday on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence, adding that the arrest was not related to other counter-terror investigations. The 41-year-old man was detained near the city of Gloucester, west England, and remains in custody.

results.title: What the hack? Europeans face growing psyops and cyberattacks
results.content: So this time, it's Iran, not Russia? France - reportedly acting on US intelligence - summoning Tehran’s ambassador over last month’s hacking of hundreds of supermarket refrigerators that overheated, 15 of which even caught fire. Why now at a time when Iran’s trying to break its international isolation?

results.title: Filming amongst body bags: New Colombian president’s comms campaign sparks backlash
results.content: Since taking office in August, new far-right Colombian president Abelardo de la Espriella has shared video after video promoting his security forces – especially operations they’ve carried out against armed groups. In some, De la Espriella speaks standing among body bags. Others feature prisoners or look like they were taken from an action film. However, there’s been growing outcry about his social media glorification of repressive policies.

results.title: French police search Ritz, glitzy Al Fayed properties in women-trafficking probe
results.content: French police have searched several properties, including the Ritz hotel in Paris, in relation to an investigation into a suspected international network trafficking women for Mohamed Al Fayed, prosecutors told AFP on Tuesday. The Ritz is just one of the late tycoon's high-end ventures where victims have said they faced abuse.

results.title: Sports legends whose political fortunes may be a lesson to Riner ahead of presidential bid
results.content: French judo star Teddy Riner may have announced his bid for the 2027 French presidential campaign on Monday, but he is not the only sports star to transition from stadium to bully pulpit. Read about some of his most famous predecessors.

results.title: Kristallnacht' 88th anniversary: Merz says Germany faces historic test over antisemitism
results.content: It has been 88 years since "Kristallnacht", the "Night of Broken Glass" in Europe, a violent pogrom against the Jewish population across Nazi Germany and Austria, marking a critical escalation toward the Holocaust. Friedrich Merz, Federal Chancellor of Germany, said that Germany currently faces a historic test over antisemitism.

results.title: US Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth calls impeachment moves 'a farce'
results.content: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday, November 10, called an effort to impeach him over ​abuse of power in the Iran war a farce and sabotage that plays into the hands of adversaries. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Commentator Douglas Herbert has more.

results.title: Who exactly is Pete Hegseth, the Pentagon chief facing an impeachment bid?
results.content: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday dismissed the impeachment effort against him as "a political spectacle". He made the comments a day after Republican Thomas Massie launched a bid to impeach him over his handling of the unpopular war in Iran and other actions. But who is Pete Hegseth? A former Fox News host and military veteran, he has become one of the most prominent figures in the Trump administration.

results.title: French students vow to keep up protest pressure for better learning conditions
results.content: France has been buffeted for months by street protests. They began in September ​with students ‌demanding the renovation of school buildings, more teachers and ⁠university reforms but then turned into broader cost-of-living protests, drawing in trade unions and political activists, and sometimes ‌turning violent.

results.title: Pope Leo XIV visits Argentina in second leg of Latin American tour
results.content: Pope Leo XIV visited Argentina on the second leg of his South American tour, following a stop in Uruguay. During his visit, he celebrated public Masses, met with the faithful and held talks with religious and government leaders. Peru is the final stop on the pontiff's tour.

results.title: REPLAY: US Secretary of State Rubio holds press conference after G7 meeting
results.content: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio talked to the press Tuesday as the G7 meets in Paris. He said he saw no need to resume major combat operations against Iran because economic restrictions were working so effectively. He also hailed US-mediated talks between Russia and Ukraine in Abu Dhabi as "very productive" and said the discussions should be expanded to include Europeans at the table.

results.title: French far right on track to secure €10 million loan for Le Pen's presidential campaign
results.content: France's far-right National Rally party on Tuesday reached a preliminary agreement with two European banks for a loan to help fund Marine Le Pen's presidential campaign. The lenders are expected to finalise the €10 million loan by the end of the month.

results.title: REPLAY: Pentagon chief Hegseth holds news briefing amid impeachment push
results.content: US ​Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday called ​moves to impeach him over abuse of power in the Iran war a "farce" that ​would ‌fail. Hegseth made the comment ⁠at a news conference – his first since May – a day after US Representative ‌Thomas Massie, a Kentucky Republican, introduced eight ⁠articles of impeachment against him. Watch our replay.

results.title: G7 talks in Paris try to tackle global crises with uncertainty high over US approach
results.content: Top diplomats from the Group of Seven industrialized democracies gathered in Paris on Monday with clear differences on global crises and questions about how U.S. President Donald Trump will approach foreign policy after his Republican Party’s heavy losses in the midterm elections. Whether on the Russia-Ukraine war, Iran or the International Criminal Court, the sides appeared far apart as two days of talks got underway, as FRANCE 24's Clovis Casali reports.

results.title: ‘It’s a farce’: Hegseth slams impeachment effort
results.content: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth dismissed a move to impeach him by a Republican lawmaker as a “farce” and a political “stunt” on Tuesday. It came a day after outgoing US Representative Thomas Massie introduced eight articles of impeachment against Hegseth over his handling of the war with Iran and other alleged abuses of power.

results.title: The robot boom: Are businesses ready for an AI-powered workforce?
results.content: As artificial intelligence makes machines more capable and autonomous, businesses are racing to embrace robotics. But while many executives expect to deploy robot fleets in the coming years, far fewer have a clear strategy for doing so. FRANCE 24's Charles Pellegrin speaks to John Healy, Intel's Vice President of Robotics and Industrial Solutions, about the opportunities, risks and workforce challenges behind the growing robot revolution.

results.title: Israel live: Netanyahu bloc targets Arab lawmakers as new parliament is sworn in
results.content: Tensions ran high at the first session of Israel's new parliament on Tuesday as rival camps traded barbs over the possibility of ruling with the support of Arab lists. The party of opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot, who has been tasked with forming a government, moved to immediately set up a commission to investigate Hamas's October 7, 2023 attack, an action long resisted by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Follow our live coverage for the latest updates.

results.title: 'Clean beauty': How to navigate the latest cosmetic and skincare trends
results.content: It's hard to believe, but Christmas is just six weeks away. That means the battle of the Advent calendars is now well and truly underway. So if you love beauty products but are wanting to buy with safety and a healthy approach in mind, what do you do? Joining us from Atlanta is Lisa Fennessy, the founder and CEO of The New Knew, which reviews "clean beauty" products. She tells us what to look out for to take better care of our skin.

results.title: Pokemon's 30-year anniversary: Japanese cards sell like wildfire
results.content: Pokemon, the famous Japanese little monsters, are turning 30, and their trading cards are selling like wildfire, often being flipped for small fortunes. People prepared to camp outside specialised shops in a bid to buy some of these cards.

results.title: Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth calls move to impeach him 'sabotage'
results.content: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday called ​moves to impeach him over abuse of power in the Iran war a "farce" that ​would ‌fail. The Pentagon chief slammed the move as a "political spectacle" by an outgoing congressional opponent of President Donald Trump, who said Hegseth deserved "an 'A' plus" for his performance.

results.title: US-mediated talks on ending Russia-Ukraine war begin in Abu Dhabi
results.content: Three-way talks between Russia, Ukraine and the US opened Tuesday, November 10, in the United Arab Emirates, as Washington made another push to end the war. The two-day session in Abu Dhabi is the first such meeting since February. It will focus on establishing future security guarantees for the warring countries.

results.title: French students block dozens of schools, vow more protests
results.content: French students blocked the entrances to dozens of high schools on Tuesday, November 10, as they kept up protests for better learning conditions. These protests across France have spiraled into larger cost-of-living demonstrations in recent weeks, some marked by violence and police brutality. FRANCE 24's Luke Shrago reports from the ground.

results.title: Ukraine peace talks: Who is sitting at the negotiating table – and why it matters
results.content: Three-way talks between Russia, Ukraine and the United States opened Tuesday in the United Arab Emirates, as Washington made a renewed push to end the war that followed Moscow's invasion of its neighbour nearly five years ago. As these two days of talks in Abu Dhabi get underway, the negotiators that each country has chosen to send tell us most of what we need to know about what will be discussed, as FRANCE 24's International Affairs Commentator Douglas Herbert explains.

results.title: Dana White: UFC chief declines Trump’s White House job offer
results.content: Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) chief Dana White made a surprise appearance at the White House on Monday to turn down Donald Trump’s offer of a job as the White House press secretary, saying he has “zero political aspirations”. Trump stunned the world on November 7 when he said on social media that he had offered White the job, only to claim a day later that he was "only kidding”.
